entities.name: Noor-ol-Hoda Mangeneh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Noor-ol-Hoda Mangeneh was an Iranian intellectual and one of the pioneering figures in the women's rights movement in Iran. She was born in Tehran. She was a member of Jam'iyat-e Nesvan-e Vatankhah and published Bibi magazine for women.
